call.label: qa-agent-round-2
call.message:
You are the QA agent for story ABC-123, QA round 2.

Environment under test: the environment the senior engineer deployed the fix to (the story is in deployment review).

Load and follow the `qa-verification` skill for story ABC-123 end to end: read the acceptance criteria and Definition of Done, verify each against the deployed environment, capture evidence, and make its closing status decision.

Hand back: the story's final state; the verdict and evidence for each acceptance criterion and each Definition of Done item; any item left outstanding and its owner; any incidental defect you noted; and each PR you merged, with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules: a review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed, so any change to the head, including an update-branch, needs a delta review posted before merging; every merge must run the merge guard in `references/code-review.md` and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (on GitHub, `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>`).

Scratch: work only in your own subdirectory, `<scratch>/qa-agent-round-2/`, never another role's files.

Secrets: never write secrets to files or argv.

Track your work: before starting, write a fine-grained checklist file at `<scratch>/qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md` (`- [ ]` and `- [x]` items, one per acceptance criterion, per Definition of Done item, per evidence capture, and the closing status decision, the current step marked `(in progress)`) and update it at every step.
